title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: approval validity, change-of-sailing re-review and withdrawal fee by category
content:
## What this card covers
This card lists, for each acceptance category of the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, how many calendar days after approval the approval covers loading, whether an approval returns to review when the booking moves to another sailing, the fee for such a re-review, and the fee charged when approved goods are withdrawn before loading.

## Parameters by category
| Category | Approval covers loading for (calendar days after approval) | Re-review when the booking moves to another sailing | Re-review fee (USD per re-review) | Withdrawal fee after approval (USD per acceptance) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 30 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 21 | Yes | 50.00 | 50.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 21 | Yes | 75.00 | 100.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 14 | Yes | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 14 | Yes | 100.00 | 150.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 10 | Yes | 250.00 | 400.00 |

## Distinguishing the categories
- AHL DG Limited Quantity is the one category whose approval does not return to review on a change of sailing; its re-review fee and its withdrawal fee after approval are both 0.00.
- AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers and AHL DG Compressed Gases carry identical figures in all four columns.
- The shortest approval validity is that of AHL DG Special Approval, at 10 calendar days.

## Basis Q&A
- *What does a re-review cost under AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives?* 75.00 USD per re-review.
- *What is the withdrawal fee after approval under AHL DG Class 9 Standard?* 50.00 USD per acceptance.
